lines.japanese:
「志貴さま、朝です。
お目覚めください」
　……聞きなれた声がする。
「志貴さま……どうかお目覚めください。
昨日に引き続き遅刻をなされると、秋葉さまとのお約束を破ることになってしまいます」
　……切迫しているのか落ち着いているのか、なかなかに判別がつきにくい声がする。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki, it’s morning. Please wake up.”
…A familiar voice.
“Master Shiki… please wake up. If you are late again today, you will break your promise to Miss Akiha.”
…The voice was strangely difficult to classify as either urgent or composed.

Please wake up."
…… I hear a familiar voice.

"Shiki-sama…… Please wake up.
If you are late like yesterday, you will break your promise with Akiha-sama."
…… A voice partly tense, partly relaxed.

lines.japanese:
「志貴さま。
よろしいのですね、今朝も秋葉さまにお叱りをうけるということで」
　……そんなの、よろしいハズがない。
「……起きる。
起きるから、ちょっと待って」
　シーツをかぶったままその返答をして、ゆっくりと目を覚ますことにした。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
“Master Shiki. Am I to understand that you wish to be scolded by Miss Akiha again this morning?”
…Of course I didn’t.
“I’m getting up. Just give me a minute.” I answered from beneath the sheet and began the slow process of waking.

lines.mirrorMoon:
"Shiki-sama.
Is it okay?
Akiha-sama will end up scolding you again."
…… No, it's not okay at all.
"…… I'm up.
I'm up, so hold on."
Still under the sheets, I respond as I slowly open my eyes.

lines.japanese:
「おはようございます、志貴さま」
「あい、おはよう」
　ねぼけた頭で挨拶を返して、メガネをかける。
　時刻は朝の七時すぎ。
　いつも通りの時間に翡翠が起こしにきて、めずらしく目を覚ました自分がいる。
「それでは朝食の支度をいたします。
着替えがすみしだい、食堂にいらしてください」
　一礼をして、翡翠は部屋から立ち去っていった。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
“Good morning, Master Shiki.” “Mornin’.” I returned the greeting through the fog in my head and put on my glasses. It was a little after seven. Hisui had come to wake me at the usual time, and, unusually, I had actually awakened.
“I will prepare breakfast. Please come to the dining room once you have dressed.”
Hisui bowed and left the room.

Hisui bowed and left the room.

"I will prepare your breakfast.
After changing, please head towards the dining room."
Hisui disappears from the room after a bow.

lines.japanese:
「は――――あ」
　大きく伸びをして、ベッドから置きあがる。
　制服に着替えて、ふと、机の上に視線を投げた。
　……机の上には、あれ以来使われる事のないナイフが置かれている。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish: “Haaah…” I stretched deeply and climbed out of bed. Once I had changed into my uniform, my eyes strayed to the desk. The knife lay there, untouched since that night.

After a nice stretch, I get up from bed.
I change into my school uniform and cast a glance at my desk.
…… On top is the knife I will not ever use again.

　ただ、吹き込む風が肌寒い。
　窓を閉めようと、窓ガラスに近づいた。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
The curtains stirred softly. Hisui must have opened the window; beyond it, the sky was brilliantly clear. The breeze coming through was cold against my skin.
I walked over to close the window.

　あの後、俺が目を覚ましたのは自分の部屋だった。

lines.maoEnglish: In the end, when I woke after everything that happened, I was back in my own room.
lines.mao_english: In the end, when I woke after everything that happened, I was back in my own room.

先輩が運んでくれたらしく、幸いにも秋葉たちには俺が部屋を出ていったという事は知られていなかった。
　あの夜から一週間。
　遠野志貴の生活は、以前とまったく変わりがない。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish: She must have carried me home. Fortunately, Akiha and the others never learned that I had left my room. A week had passed since that night. The life of Shiki Tohno was exactly as it had been before.
lines.mao_english: She must have carried me home. Fortunately, Akiha and the others never learned that I had left my room. A week had passed since that night. The life of Shiki Tohno was exactly as it had been before.

lines.japanese:
秋葉との関係は、多少、なんとなく気まずいものがあるものの、やっぱり兄と妹なわけで。
　学校のほうは渡り廊下を修理中という事を除けば以前と何一つ変わっていない。
　……いや、変わったか。
　学校には、シエルなんていう名前の先輩はどこにもいないし、誰も覚えてさえいない。
　街を騒がしていた通り魔事件もあれから一件だって起きていない。
犯人が捕まったわけではないので相変わらず夜の街は寂しいけれど、あと一ヶ月もすればもとの夜に戻るだろう。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
Things with Akiha were a little awkward in ways neither of us could quite name, but we were still brother and sister. School was unchanged too, apart from the enclosed walkway being under repair.
…No, something had changed. There was no upperclassman named Ciel anywhere in the school, and no one even remembered her. Nor had there been a single new killing in the series that had terrorized the city. The culprit had never been caught, so the streets remained deserted at night, but in another month they would probably return to normal.

俺は、結局。
　胸の中に埋めようのない穴を持ったまま、それでも以前のようにやっていけている。
　……というか、耐えていけている。
　時折、何の拍子もなく思い出してしまうとそれこそどうしようもなくなるけど、まだ気が触れる事はなさそうだ。
　いつか。
　この思いに耐えきれなくなってどうにかなってしまうのか、それともそれにさえ慣れて、普通に暮らしていけるようになるのか。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
And I was still here. There was a hole in my chest that nothing could ever fill, yet somehow I continued living as before. Or rather, I endured. Sometimes a stray thought brought everything back and left me helpless—but I did not seem to be losing my mind just yet.
Someday, perhaps the grief would become unbearable and break me. Or perhaps I would grow accustomed even to this and learn to live an ordinary life again.

lines.mirrorMoon:
As for me,
I carry an unfillable void in my heart, but I continue on as I did before.
…… Or rather, I can bear it all.
At times, I get overwhelmed when I am assailed by memories, but I don't think I'll go insane or anything for now.
Some day.
Will I go crazy after not being able to bear these memories, or will I just return to living normally after getting used to them?

「――――秋も、じき終わりかな」
　外は、息がつまりそうなほど蒼い空。
　一度だけ大きく深呼吸をして、窓ガラスをぱたんと閉めた。
lines.label: s52
lines.maoEnglish:
I gave either outcome even odds. Until then, though—pathetic as it might be—I found myself keeping my final promise to her almost every day.
“Autumn will be over soon.”
Outside, the sky was blue enough to steal my breath. I drew one deep lungful of air, then gently shut the window.

lines.mirrorMoon:
Perhaps it's about a fifty-fifty chance.

even if it is a little girlish, I keep the final promise I made with her every day.
"----Autumn is drawing to a close, isn't it?"
The blue sky outside is enough to take my breath away.
Taking a large, deep breath, I shut the window.

　窓の向こうには燃えるような夕暮れが広がっている。
　深空に沈むように、真っ赤な太陽がとけていく。
「―――――」
　ずっと、こうして待っている。
　彼女との約束を覚えていて、それを忘れられないかぎり、ずっとここで待ち続ける。
lines.label: s52a
lines.maoEnglish:
Even after classes ended and the classroom emptied, I never returned to the mansion before sunset.
A red classroom. Beyond the windows, the evening burned. The scarlet sun dissolved as if sinking into the deepest reaches of the sky. “…” I waited here day after day. As long as I remembered my promise to her—as long as I could not forget it—I would go on waiting.

　彼女は、不思議そうに首をかしげていたっけ。

“When everything is over—after we defeat the vampire—why don’t we spend another day like this before we part?”
She had tilted her head, puzzled.

　心の中では、ただ、彼女のことだけを考えていた。
lines.label: s52a
lines.maoEnglish:
“So I wondered… once there are no obligations left between us, what it would be like to meet again for no reason at all.”
…That was what I had said aloud. In my heart, I had been thinking only of her.

　きっと、彼女は喜ぶって思えたあの時。

…Not as partners bound by a common task. Just as friends who liked each other, meeting casually and making an ordinary memory together.

　この朱色が消え去るまでの数時間。
　真紅の空気がなくなるまでの静かな時間。
　永遠にも一瞬にも感じられる、止まった世界。
　もしかすると、とっくに自分は気が触れているのかもしれない。
　来るはずのない相手を待っているっていうのに、心はひどく落ち着いている。

Perhaps I had already gone mad. I was waiting for someone who could never come, yet my heart was utterly calm.

　幻なんかじゃないのに、

lines.maoEnglish: She remained by the window, making no move to come closer. She was truly before me, no illusion at all, yet I felt a distance between us that no hand could ever cross. “…” I could not speak. But my heart was strangely calm.

　結局、わたし以外の真祖はみんなそいつに殺されちゃった」

lines.maoEnglish:
“I never told you why I was hunting Roa, did I? A very long time ago, I drank human blood once. That human stole part of my power and became an extraordinarily powerful Dead Apostle. In the end, he killed every other True Ancestor.”
That meant—
“That was Roa?”

「そう。
その時まで、わたしは吸血衝動っていうものを知らなかった。
他の真祖たちも、わたしにだけは無いんだって信じてたみたい。
　けど、わたしは単に来るのが遅かっただけ。
その時まで―――わたし、自分が吸血種だなんてことを知らなかった。
　だから―――アレが、いけないコトなんだっていうことも、わからなかった」
　……そうか。
　何一つ余分なことを教えられなかった彼女は、自分が殺してまわる相手と同じものだということさえ、教えられなかったんだ。
lines.label: s52a
lines.maoEnglish: “Yes. Until then, I had never known a vampiric impulse. The other True Ancestors believed I alone had been born without one. But mine had simply come late. Until that day, I never even knew I belonged to a vampiric species. So I didn’t understand that what I did was wrong.” Of course. They had taught her nothing beyond what they considered necessary—not even that she was the same kind of creature as those she had been made to hunt.
lines.mao_english: “Yes. Until then, I had never known a vampiric impulse. The other True Ancestors believed I alone had been born without one. But mine had simply come late. lines.mirrorMoon:
"Yes.

But, it was too late.
Until then----I didn't even know I was a vampire.
So----I didn't even know it was something I shouldn't do."
…… I see.
Never having been taught anything extra, she wasn't even taught she was the same as those she killed.

"…… You really are kind, Shiki.
Yeah, I knew coming here to say goodbye was a good thing.
I love you, Shiki.
Your honesty, how you are always spaced out, how I'm the only one you yell at, how you always look forward to the future… I love all of you.
So please, keep living like that, okay?"
For just an instant,
she smiles sadly.
She waves her hand, and as if fading into the sunset itself, she disappears before my very eyes.

「………そっか。
約束、守ったじゃないか、おまえ」
　この教室で。
　夕暮れの教室でまた会おうっていう約束は、ちゃんと守られた。

lines.maoEnglish:

When I thought about it, every meeting ended in parting. Ours had simply come sooner than most. Seen that way, perhaps it had been a farewell I could accept. She had been alive. She had said she was happy. She had… said…

lines.maoEnglish:
“You… idiot…”
That had been her final wish. No matter how much it hurt, she had asked me to keep muddling through for now, to face forward and go on living until the day I could look back on this as a memory. She had left me that wish with a smile. “Ghh…!” Impossible. I had no confidence at all that I could live that way.

I---I don't have the slightest confidence to live like that.

A dark night sky. Clouds curling in a spiral, and a moon that shone pure white.
That was all that remained. And yet it was a memory of extraordinary beauty.
